值得閱讀的理由

  • 一次認識三款風格迥異的成人向遊戲，從荒島求生、地城動作到劇情 RPG 都有涵蓋。
  • 整理了各作品的玩法、劇情與美術特色，也指出操作、敘事和音量等缺點，方便讀者評估是否值得入手。
  • 深入分享第三款作品的純愛與 NTR 路線，呈現作者對角色魅力及情感衝擊的真實感受。

摘要

本月遊戲回顧

作者 NO 開場介紹本月的 Steam 成人向遊戲回顧，表示本月有兩款少見的荒島題材作品，以及一款令人心碎、但表現出色的 NTR 遊戲。他也提到自己開設了 Discord 討論頻道，並整理過往介紹的遊戲清單；加入 YouTube 會員則可先看每月評論的精華預覽。

《漂流島》：輕鬆的荒島求生

《漂流島》售價 216 元，有 180 則評論，評價為「極度好評」91%。主角與伴侶因旅行意外漂流到荒島，必須靠探索與收集資源求生。遊戲採用回合制與時段安排，白天可前往森林、海岸或草原探索；行動需要擲骰判定，成功便能取得較多資源。玩家也能製作工具提升判定能力，或利用剩餘體力與精神訓練角色，累積經驗並強化能力。

遊戲難度不高，確保食物與飲水充足，就能逐步收集材料、製作木筏並嘗試逃離。即使逃脫失敗，角色也會回到島上重新嘗試，恢復機制相當寬容。夜晚則能與女主角交談、培養感情，達到條件後解鎖親密場景。作者認為場景篇幅稍短，但女主角活潑率直、遇到害羞情境又會臉紅，反差相當可愛；除了遊戲音量偏小之外，整體體驗十分出色。

《獸人少女與地下城》：美術有亮點，體驗不理想

《獸人少女與地下城》的故事描述一名獸人少女為了照顧受傷的父親，自願加入王國冒險公會，卻因人類同伴排斥而被推入地城。作者批評劇情留下大量未解之謎，包括獸人受歧視的原因、女主角在地城的遭遇，以及反派動機；結局還突然走向悲劇，卻沒有充分交代原因。

玩法主要是重複探索地城與戰鬥，移動、戰鬥互動和地圖設計都顯得老舊。頭目血量高、幾乎不會硬直，玩家只能等待攻擊空檔慢慢削血，戰鬥過程令人煎熬。配樂也缺乏銜接，探索時的舒緩音樂會突然切換成音量很大的搖滾樂。雖然親密場景包含大型插圖與像素美術，風格也有些新鮮感，但部分昆蟲與蜘蛛動畫讓作者不太舒服；他認為本作整體平庸，不值得原價購買，建議等特價再考慮。

第三款作品：三條路線與令人心碎的 NTR

第三款作品售價 388 元，影片提到其評論多為「極度好評」、好評比例達 95%，但未說出遊戲名稱。故事從一座神祕島嶼現身開始：失去記憶的冒險者在島上醒來，遇見虔誠的白髮女主角，隨後又與熱愛歷史的紅髮考古學家同行。遊戲採用輕鬆易上手的 RPG 玩法，主線分成主角、白髮女主角與紅髮女主角三條路線，分別探索記憶、信仰與歷史；完成全部路線，才能拼出島嶼的秘密。作者特別喜歡三人相處與鬥嘴的描寫，認為角色關係討喜，讓冒險過程格外溫馨。

然而，開發團隊 AfanG 擅長 NTR 題材，作品真正的情感重擊也藏在相關路線中。玩家若選擇嘗試 NTR，便會看見女主角從勉強順從，逐漸受到引誘、沉溺其中，最後陷入背叛關係。作者表示，兩位女主角原本十分可愛，自己也在旅途中對她們產生深厚感情，因此劇情帶來的心碎與痛苦格外強烈；他甚至懊悔自己選擇了 NTR 路線，向畫面中的女主角道歉，懇求她們不要離開。

作者強烈推薦這款作品給 NTR 愛好者，認為相關內容豐富，情感衝擊也相當到位。不喜歡 NTR 的玩家仍可選擇純愛結局，而且純愛內容本身也做得不錯；不過作者半開玩笑地鼓勵玩家試試 NTR 路線，也提及發行商 Linchpao 將舉辦抽獎活動。

Ha, hello everyone, I'm NO. Welcome to the Gentleman's Monthly Review, where we check out the latest gentleman's games on Steam each month. This month features two rare desert island themed games, both quite good, plus a heartbreaking NTR title—painful, but excellent. Before we start, I've opened a Discord channel to discuss adult and ACG topics , and I've organized a list of all the games I've covered; feel free to stop by if you're interested. For those who join as YT members, I'll. post a short preview of the key content from each month's review to help you decide which games to pick up. Alright, let's see what goodies were released this month. "Drifting Island," priced at 216 NTD, with 180 reviews and a 91%Very Positive rating. It follows a protagonist and their partner who, after a travel accident, drift to a desert island and begin a survival journey; it's a turn-based game divided into time slots. During the day, you choose areas to explore and gather resources. Once the exploration bar is full, you.

# 與你流落荒島

unlock main features for that area, like woodcutting in the forest, fishing at the shore, or hunting in the grassland. However, every action requires a dice roll check; success yields plenty, while failure yields little. The game isn't too difficult, so don't worry if you have bad luck; the most important thing is to ensure you have food and water. After taking a few actions during the day, you head into the night. Besides the daily food consumption, you can use collected resources to craft. stone knives, axes, or fishing rods, which give bonuses to your checks. You can also spend remaining stamina and mental energy to train your stats. Gradually, whatever you do—whether training or gathering—earns you experience points, which can be used to invest in talents or boost your character attributes. It makes your gameplay smoother as you progress; it's quite a solid experience. Though you start out nervous and in bad shape, for some reason, once you gather resources, your status improves, and resources won't feel as scarce later on. Although it’s a bit strange, the gameplay is generally quite relaxing. You gradually collect resources, build a raft, and process food before attempting to escape the desert island. Succeeding lets you see one of the endings, and failing is fine too—you just drift back to the island to try again. The recovery mechanics are actually pretty good. During your rest period each night, you can chat and bond with the heroine to increase her affection level. Once you reach a certain threshold, you can view special intimate scenes. While it's a shame that most of these scenes are a bit short—limiting their replay value—. the heroine is just so adorable. A tomboy with an outgoing personality, she still blushes when faced with embarrassing situations. That kind of contrast is really "kawaii"; even if the intensity isn't high, it’s great for stirring up emotions. If I had to name a flaw, it’s that the game's volume is strangely low; I have to adjust it every time I play. But setting that aside, this is an excellent game. "Orc Girl and the Dungeon" costs 219 yuan, has 250 reviews , and holds an 87% "Very Positive"

# 貓與地下城

rating. The kingdom suddenly starts forcibly conscripting people for manual labor. Since the heroine's father is injured, she volunteers to join the kingdom's adventure guild. However, because humans discriminate against orcs, her human teammates eventually get fed up with her and push her into the depths of the dungeon. Luckily, she’s fine and makes her way back to the kingdom to keep working as an adventurer. That said, the story is pretty poor; most of the foreshadowing planted at the beginning is never resolved by the. ending. Why are orcs so severely discriminated against? The game doesn't say. What was the heroine's encounter in the dungeon? The game doesn't say. Why is the villain a villain? The game doesn't say. It even hits you with a sudden tragic ending, but doesn't explain why—the whole experience leaves you with nothing but question marks. As for the gameplay, it’s just filler to pad out the story, consisting of repetitive dungeon crawling. You just equip elemental weapons and attack, and it doesn't really feel that fun to play . Everything from movement and combat interactions to map design feels like a relic from a past generation. When you. see an enemy, you either kite them from a distance or figure out how to burst them down. Regarding boss battles, the bosses have a lot of HP, and it’s clear the development team had technical limitations. Bosses have almost no hit stun, so they just relentlessly attack while you have to constantly wait for openings to chip away at their health. It feels inexplicably masochistic; the combat is just quite painful. It feels like an action game forced into a turn-based format, and the background music is just bizarrely paired. The music while exploring and fighting early bosses is.

soothing, but then it suddenly shifts to rock music for late-game key bosses. This switch without any buildup feels disjointed, and the sudden increase in volume actually startled me—it was just way too abrupt. The "mana replenishment " scenes are a bit underwhelming because most are tied to losing battles. Since the game isn't very difficult, it’s easier to just finish the game and unlock the CGs to view them later. However, the scenes themselves are decent, featuring both large-scale illustrations and small pixel art. I think it’s the art style—it’s just. barely passing but sits at a "youthful" stage—that gives it a strange sense of novelty for someone like me who is used to more mature art styles. The large illustrations have some appeal for me, while the pixel art is just classic pixel fare. Fans of the style will enjoy it, though some animations involving bugs and spiders made me cringe, which is why I’d rate it as average. Overall, this is a very mediocre title, and honestly, not one I’d really recommend. You can play it, but it’s nothing special; it feels like a product. designed by a student team. If you're interested, it's not worth the full price—I’d suggest waiting for a sale. To reiterate, it’s priced at 388 NTD, and the reviews are mostly "Very Positive" at 95%. One day, a mysterious island emerges, and people flock to investigate . The protagonist wakes up somewhere on the island; he seems to be an adventurer but has lost all his memories. He only knows that the island feels connected to him. He then conveniently encounters the kind and devout priestess (the "white" heroine), and they begin their adventure together. During their journey, they.

meet a lively archaeologist (the "red" heroine) who is passionate about history . Since everyone's goal is to investigate the island, they decide to team up. The gameplay is a typical RPG where you follow the main story and roam around fighting monsters. It’s quite casual and relaxing; as long as you fight the enemies you encounter and level up, you’ll almost never get stuck . The unique aspect of the game is that the main story splits into three routes : the protagonist's, the white heroine's , and the red heroine's. Each route focuses on different plot points—the protagonist’s is about finding lost. memories, the white heroine’s centers on faith, and the red heroine’s on history . Regardless, you have to complete all routes to piece together the secrets of the island. The plot is much like the others—casual and relaxing. You might face tough battles or plot twists, but the battles aren't too hard and the twists aren't too sharp; it's like a hero defeating a demon lord, which is only natural—the real fun is in the journey. The way these three banter and build their relationship is actually well-written, making it feel endearing and bringing a smile to your face as you. play. However, I always felt this wouldn't last. Since it's a "niche" game, the team set up a standard, crowd-pleasing plot as a frame, but focused all their effort on the "mana replenishing" scenes, making those parts exceptionally painful and the twists incredibly shocking. In case you don't know the developer, AfanG, most of their works are NTR-focused. Their art style is top-tier and their depiction of internal struggle is excellent, which makes them very... giving the NTR gameplay a try. If you choose to try it, oh boy, you're in for it—you'll get to see even more NTR " mana replenishing" content than you would otherwise. our protagonist heads out to investigate , which is how the game begins. The story is simple, without any overly complex twists or turns. The gameplay is a side-scrolling style similar to*Mega Man*. It plays quite generically, and the hit detection isn't very precise, so it gets a bit boring by the end. The dev team might have realized this,. so after the main story, they added side-story content where the perspective shifts to a very powerful companion, and you can control them to play through some levels in a "musou" style. 作者 NO 開場介紹本月的 Steam 成人向遊戲回顧，表示本月有兩款少見的荒島題材作品，以及一款令人心碎、但表現出色的 NTR 遊戲。他也提到自己開設了 Discord 討論頻道，並整理過往介紹的遊戲清單；加入 YouTube 會員則可先看每月評論的精華預覽。

《漂流島》：輕鬆的荒島求生

《漂流島》售價 216 元，有 180 則評論，評價為「極度好評」91%。主角與伴侶因旅行意外漂流到荒島，必須靠探索與收集資源求生。遊戲採用回合制與時段安排，白天可前往森林、海岸或草原探索；行動需要擲骰判定，成功便能取得較多資源。玩家也能製作工具提升判定能力，或利用剩餘體力與精神訓練角色，累積經驗並強化能力。

遊戲難度不高，確保食物與飲水充足，就能逐步收集材料、製作木筏並嘗試逃離。即使逃脫失敗，角色也會回到島上重新嘗試，恢復機制相當寬容。夜晚則能與女主角交談、培養感情，達到條件後解鎖親密場景。作者認為場景篇幅稍短，但女主角活潑率直、遇到害羞情境又會臉紅，反差相當可愛；除了遊戲音量偏小之外，整體體驗十分出色。

《獸人少女與地下城》：美術有亮點，體驗不理想

《獸人少女與地下城》的故事描述一名獸人少女為了照顧受傷的父親，自願加入王國冒險公會，卻因人類同伴排斥而被推入地城。作者批評劇情留下大量未解之謎，包括獸人受歧視的原因、女主角在地城的遭遇，以及反派動機；結局還突然走向悲劇，卻沒有充分交代原因。

玩法主要是重複探索地城與戰鬥，移動、戰鬥互動和地圖設計都顯得老舊。頭目血量高、幾乎不會硬直，玩家只能等待攻擊空檔慢慢削血，戰鬥過程令人煎熬。配樂也缺乏銜接，探索時的舒緩音樂會突然切換成音量很大的搖滾樂。雖然親密場景包含大型插圖與像素美術，風格也有些新鮮感，但部分昆蟲與蜘蛛動畫讓作者不太舒服；他認為本作整體平庸，不值得原價購買，建議等特價再考慮。

第三款作品：三條路線與令人心碎的 NTR

第三款作品售價 388 元，影片提到其評論多為「極度好評」、好評比例達 95%，但未說出遊戲名稱。故事從一座神祕島嶼現身開始：失去記憶的冒險者在島上醒來，遇見虔誠的白髮女主角，隨後又與熱愛歷史的紅髮考古學家同行。遊戲採用輕鬆易上手的 RPG 玩法，主線分成主角、白髮女主角與紅髮女主角三條路線，分別探索記憶、信仰與歷史；完成全部路線，才能拼出島嶼的秘密。作者特別喜歡三人相處與鬥嘴的描寫，認為角色關係討喜，讓冒險過程格外溫馨。

然而，開發團隊 AfanG 擅長 NTR 題材，作品真正的情感重擊也藏在相關路線中。玩家若選擇嘗試 NTR，便會看見女主角從勉強順從，逐漸受到引誘、沉溺其中，最後陷入背叛關係。作者表示，兩位女主角原本十分可愛，自己也在旅途中對她們產生深厚感情，因此劇情帶來的心碎與痛苦格外強烈；他甚至懊悔自己選擇了 NTR 路線，向畫面中的女主角道歉，懇求她們不要離開。

作者強烈推薦這款作品給 NTR 愛好者，認為相關內容豐富，情感衝擊也相當到位。不喜歡 NTR 的玩家仍可選擇純愛結局，而且純愛內容本身也做得不錯；不過作者半開玩笑地鼓勵玩家試試 NTR 路線，也提及發行商 Linchpao 將舉辦抽獎活動。

unlock main features for that area, like woodcutting in the forest, fishing at the shore, or hunting in the grassland. rating. The kingdom suddenly starts forcibly conscripting people for manual labor. Since the heroine's father is injured, she volunteers to join the kingdom's adventure guild. 玩法主要是重複探索地城與戰鬥，移動、戰鬥互動和地圖設計都顯得老舊。頭目血量高、幾乎不會硬直，玩家只能等待攻擊空檔慢慢削血，戰鬥過程令人煎熬。配樂也缺乏銜接，探索時的舒緩音樂會突然切換成音量很大的搖滾樂。雖然親密場景包含大型插圖與像素美術，風格也有些新鮮感，但部分昆蟲與蜘蛛動畫讓作者不太舒服；他認為本作整體平庸，不值得原價購買，建議等特價再考慮。

歷史戰略與奇幻冒險特惠

作者首先推薦了以歐洲七年戰爭為背景的軍事策略遊戲《指揮大師》（Master of Command）。該作迎來歷史新低折扣，核心玩法聚焦於當時主流的線列步兵交火，玩家需指揮步兵、騎兵與砲兵走位與索敵，並在具備隨機事件與資源搜刮機制的沙盒戰役中壯大部隊，題材相當罕見且具深度。

緊接著介紹的是奇幻動作冒險遊戲《Philip WH F4P head》，玩家扮演具備男女形態切換能力的見習魔女，透過跑酷躲避陷阱並挑戰強大頭目。遊戲美術風格宛如二十年前的懷舊復古風，並融入了成人互動與支線獎勵，作者也順勢結合幽默的周邊抽獎與雙十一贊助工商進行趣味分享。

節奏音樂與自然生態模擬

對於喜愛音樂與策略的玩家，作者推薦了知名節奏遊戲外傳《節奏地牢》（Crypt of the NecroDancer）衍生作，玩家需跟隨音樂節拍輸入方向鍵擊敗怪物，多樣化的節拍規則與機關大幅提升了操作挑戰。另一款則是備受好評的策略模擬遊戲《地下蟻國》（Empires of the Undergrowth），玩家需操控具備基因融合能力的雜交蟻群，藉由費洛蒙標記指揮工蟻與兵蟻分工作業，逐步壯大巢穴並擊退蠍子與青蛙等強大掠食者。
